Hi Liam — thanks for the note and attachments. Quick checklist so we can move the vendor to full onboarding and evaluate the PO request: 

1) Correct tax form: please provide a signed W-9 PDF from BridgePoint Analytics, Inc. (legal name should match your invoices). A scanned signed W-9 is acceptable; notarization is only required if the payee name / EIN has an unresolved mismatch.

2) EIN evidence: the EIN verification letter (CP575) or a recent IRS EIN confirmation letter is preferred. The image you sent helps, but we'll need a clear copy showing the entity name and EIN.

3) Legacy PO override: Procurement policy requires a limited temporary PO when reusing legacy numbers during an ERP migration. Monica (cc'd) — can you confirm the allowable cap and conditions? We typically allow a 60-day temporary activation with a $25k cap pending full EIN/W-9 verification.

4) Signer authority: if the W-9 is signed by an agent, please include a short authorizing statement or a power-of-attorney snippet.

If you can send the W-9 and a higher-resolution EIN letter, we can begin provisional activation. DocuSign is fine. If easier, send the corrected documents to accounts-payable@bridgepoint.com and cc me.

I'll loop Procurement and Vendor Ops to expedite.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Vendor Onboarding Lead

Hi Liam — copying Procurement intake.

We can approve a temporary PO override under the following conditions:
- Temporary PO: PO-100764-temp, activation window 2026-12-03 to 2027-01-10
- Spend cap: $25,000 total across all invoices charged to the temp PO
- Required documents: final signed W-9 + IRS EIN confirmation (clear scan or CP575). If the scanned EIN letter has any redactions or unclear name mapping, we will need a notarized copy.
- Invoice remit instructions must list BridgePoint Analytics, Inc. (Delaware), and the invoice must include your registered address on the W-9.

Please upload the final W-9 and EIN letter to our secure vendor portal (link below) and reply when uploaded so Vendor Ops can finalize the activation. Once documents are verified, we'll lift the cap and transition to the permanent PO issued after your ERP cutover.

Portal upload: https://app.procure.redwood.com/vendor-upload/BridgePoint
Proc ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-4682

Attachments: PO-100764_temp-note.pdf
